page.layout: One column of dictionary entries, Hebrew headwords at the left with Latin glosses and Hebrew examples. Running head at top left (Hebrew letter), page number at top right. Catchword at bottom right. No margin notes.

main_text.p: יָגוֹן m. Mœror, Mœstitia: יָגוֹן וַאֲנָחָה Mœror & genitus, Jesa.35.10. Aff. מִיגוֹנָם וְשִׂמְחָתִים Exhilarabo eos & mœrore ipsorum, Jer.31.13.
תּוּגָה f. Idem: וְאַחֲרִיתָהּ שִׂמְחָה תּוּגָה Exitus gaudii est mœstitia, Prov.14.13. Constr. תּוּגַת אָפּוֹ Mœror matris suæ est, Prov.10.1.

יָגַע Laboravit, Fatigatus, Defatigatus fuit: Præt. לְרִיק יָגַעְתִּי Frustra laboravi, Jesa.49.4. Futur. לָמָּה זֶה יָגַע הֶבֶל Ut quid in vanum laborabo, Job.9.29. Pih. Fut. אַל־תְּיַגַּע Ne fatiges, laborare facias, Jos.7.3. Hiph. Præter. הוּגַעְתָּנִי Fatigasti me, Jes.43.24.
יָגֵעַ m. Lassus, Defatigatus: עָיֵף וְיָגֵעַ Lassus & defatigatus, Deut.25.18. Plural. כָּל־הַדְּבָרִים יְגֵעִים Omnes res laboriosæ, labore plenæ sunt, Eccles.1.8.
יְגִיעִי m. Idem: Plural. Constr. כֹּחַ יְגִיעֵי Defesi viribus, Job.3.17.

יְגִיעַ m. Labor: metonymicè Facultates, sic dicta, quòd Labore comparentur: פְּנֵי־יְגִיעַ וְאֶת־יְגִיעַ Et laborem manuum mearum vidit Deus, Gen.31.42. יְגִיעֲךָ יֹאכַל Laborem tuum comedet, Deut.28.33. Plurale cum Aff. כָּל־יְגִיעִי Omnes labores mei, Hos.12.8. Fœm. Constr. יְגִיעַת בָּשָׂר Fatigatio carnis est, Eccles.12.12.
יָגַע m. Idem: מֵשִׁיב יְגַע Repetens vel Reddens laborem, Job.28.v.18.
יָגַר Metuit, Formidavit, Reformidavit: Præter. יָגֹרְתִּי מִפְּנֵיהֶם Metuisti ab illis, Deuteron.28.v.60. וַאֲשֶׁר יָגֹרְתִּי Et quod formidabam, Job.3.25.
יָגוֹר m. Timens: אַתָּה יָגוֹר מִפְּנֵיהֶם A quibus tu formidans es, Jer.22.25[?]. id est, quos tu times vel horres.
יָגַר m. Chald. Cumulus, Acervus: יְגַר שָׂהֲדוּתָא Cumulus testimonii, Genes.31.47. Usurpatur autem à Labane, tanquam proprium nomen.

page.notes: Hebrew glosses and the Hebrew verse references were read from a small scan; the vowel points and some letters of the example phrases in the entries יָגַע (Pih. Fut., Futur.), יְגִיעַ (Constr. and Plural) and יָגוֹר are uncertain and may be misprinted. "Jer.22.25" is hard to read and may be Jer.42.25. Long s has been read as s throughout; "Jof" and "Hof" read as Jos. and Hos. The running head and catchword are Hebrew letters as printed.
